messages:
lena: Post-GA follow-up: we've got competing asks from an early enterprise customer (private deployment tweaks) and broad user bug reports. Need to decide sequencing and comms.
miguel: Enterprise wants enhanced audit logs + auth header rotation support. That's medium-risk (infra + config). They pushed for a same-week fix.
sara: Broad bug is a UI threading glitch that affects ~7% of users on Mac. Low-risk front-end fix. We can ship in a micro-patch fast.
yuki: My take: prioritize low-risk, high-user-impact fix first (UI). Enterprise infra changes should be in a separate promo with signed customer SLA and regression window.
lena: Agree. Also, enterprise asks need private deployment validation — allocate a dedicated test tenant. That adds ~48h acceptance.
miguel: True. If we do UI fix now, we reduce support load and buy time for the enterprise work. Ops: can we schedule a private-tenant validation next week?
ops-bot: Private tenant provisioning ETA: 36h. Added temp alert: auditlog-rate > baseline -> page infra.
deploy-bot: Suggested plan: promote/ui-fix/4929998887 at 03:00 UTC -> watch 8h. Then schedule enterprise/priv-deploy/4929998887-1 after tenant ready.
sara: I'll open the UI PR now, include a small e2e smoke and two screenshots. PR title: fix/ui-threading-mac-4929998887
miguel: For enterprise work I'll draft a validation checklist: config matrix, KMS rotation test, audit log tailing. Will share by EOD.
yuki: Acceptance gates: UI fix -> smoke green + <1.0% error delta. Enterprise -> signed runbook + tenant green + legal signoff. No bundling.
lena: Good. Add backlog tags: patch/ui-4929998887, infra/priv-4929998887. Quick sync 11:00 to confirm tenant timing. Thanks :white_check_mark:
